Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so your team has a single place to reference: 

- Primary use case: customer-facing embeddings/reranking for fraud detection and account insights (low to medium prompt complexity).
- Estimated peak throughput: ~120 concurrent requests, ~40k tokens/day today with growth to ~250k in 12 months.
- Data residency / isolation: NovaBank requires network isolation and keys managed by the bank for production data (leaning toward VPC/on-prem requirement).
- Latency target: 150–300ms p95 for single-request inference.
- Security items: SOC 2, audit logs, and customer-managed KMS called out by your InfoSec team.

Recommendation / next steps:
1) We discussed two deployment options: Hosted with strict controls vs Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) for full network isolation. Based on your requirements, Private (VPC) looks like the best fit for production.
2) I attached a short outline of the VPC offering and a SOC 2 summary (attachment). If useful I can also share a pricing sketch for Dedicated/VPC.
3) Proposed next step: intro call with your procurement + InfoSec (30 min) to run through compliance & procurement timeline.
